@: First-run setup wizard, Settings > Add-ons rows, the download item in the status bar (web/js/setup.js). The wizard is for first-time users: plain words, no tool names.
pack.ready_cuda: ready: used from the next transcription
toast.cuda_ready: Fast speech on your graphics card is ready. It is used from the next transcription.
@toast.pack_note: {note} is a short status text the app sends (for example why nothing was installed).
toast.pack_failed: {title}: the download stopped. Settings > Add-ons can try again.
toast.pack_stopped: {title}: stopped (Retry goes on where it stopped)
toast.saved_no_installs: Saved. The downloads can be started from Settings > Add-ons.
toast.skip_failed: Could not save that. Try again in a moment.
toast.skipped: Setup skipped. Settings > Add-ons has “Run setup again”.
toast.escape: Finish the steps, or use “Skip setup” at the bottom.
confirm.remove: Remove {title}? Its downloaded files are deleted; you can install it again later.
confirm.remove_model: Remove {title}? Its downloaded files are deleted; you can install it again later. Other programs on this PC that use the same speech model (Hugging Face cache) lose it too.
@progress.of: {pct} = percent done, {done} / {total} = sizes such as 120 MB.
upd.link_title: A newer WardogClips release: open its download page
upd.no_repo: No repository set: fill in the field above (owner/name) to check for releases.
addons.load_failed: The add-on list could not be loaded. Close Settings and open it again.
@gpu.ready: {card} = the card's name, memory and driver, for example: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 · 16 GB · driver 560.94
gpu.ready: {card}: speech turns into text on the graphics card
gpu.not_ready: {card}: speech can turn into text on the graphics card once the speech engine below is installed
gpu.none: No NVIDIA graphics card: speech turns into text on the processor (slower; the Standard speech model is the sensible pick)
step.name: Your name
hw.title: This PC
hw.other_html: Graphics card: {name} — it speeds up video work, but transcription runs on the processor (slower)
hw.no_nvidia: No NVIDIA graphics card — transcription runs on the processor (slower)
hw.obs_found_paths: OBS found — we'll suggest its recording folder
hw.obs_found: OBS found — you'll pick its recording folder next
hw.obs_missing: OBS not found — you'll pick your recordings folder next
hw.resolve: DaVinci Resolve found — your best moments can go straight into it
welcome.title: Welcome to WardogClips
welcome.lead: WardogClips watches your game recordings for you and finds the moments worth keeping: kills, assists, deaths and the things you and your squad said.
welcome.hint: WardogClips only reads your videos. It never touches the game or changes your files, and everything stays on this PC. You can change every answer later in Settings.
root.cant_check: can't check this folder right now
folders.none: No folder yet: add the folder OBS saves your recordings in.
folders.title: Where does OBS save your recordings?
folders.lead: Check the folders that hold your recordings and replays. Folders inside them count too. WardogClips only reads them: nothing is moved or changed.
folders.path_ph: or paste a folder path and press Enter
folders.skip: Skip for now: I'll add folders later in Settings
chips.name_ph: type your name and press Enter
chips.squad_ph: type a name and press Enter
you.title: What's your in-game name?
you.lead: So we can tell your kills from everyone else's in the kill feed.
you.name: Your in-game name
you.name_help: Exactly as the kill feed shows it, without a clan tag. Play under more than one? Add them all.
you.squad_help: The people you usually play with, so their kills count as your team's.
lang.auto: Different languages: detect it for each speaker
lang.title: What language do you and your squad speak?
lang.help: Irish, Quechua, Guarani and Aymara can't be turned into text yet: pick the closest language or “detect”.
choice.fast_text: Uses your NVIDIA graphics card. Best results.
choice.standard_lighter: Lighter and a little less accurate.
choice.standard_cpu: Runs on the processor: slower, no graphics card download.
choice.standard_good: Runs on the processor. Good results.
choice.keep_text: The speech model picked in Settings > Add-ons.
speech.title: Turn speech into searchable text?
speech.lead: WardogClips can write down what you and your squad say, so you can search it later, and it marks the moments you got loud. It all happens on this PC: nothing is uploaded.
speech.switch_help: Off: no text and no voice moments. Everything else still works.
speech.other_card: Your graphics card is not an NVIDIA card, and the fast speech engine only runs on NVIDIA cards, so speech turns into text on the processor: Standard is the best fit.
speech.no_card: This PC has no NVIDIA graphics card, so speech turns into text on the processor: Standard is the best fit.
speech.models_hint: Want a specific speech model? Settings > Add-ons lists them all.
vod.is_file: That's a file, not a folder: pick another
vods.title: Stream recordings too?
vods.lead: Do you also want to download stream recordings (VODs) from YouTube, Twitch, Kick, TikTok or Rumble? WardogClips finds the best moments in them like in your own footage.
vods.yes_help: Paste a link to a stream any time, or follow your favorite streamers.
vods.not_now_help: You can start any time later from the VODs button.
vods.deno: YouTube needs a small helper ({size}) — it downloads with the rest.
wiz.cuda: Speech engine for your graphics card
wiz.failed: The download stopped. Check your internet connection, then press Retry.
wiz.stopped: Stopped. Press Retry to go on where it stopped.
finish.title: Ready to start
finish.lead_scan: Here is what you picked. Press Start and WardogClips begins looking through your footage.
finish.lead_save: Here is what you picked. Press Start to save it.
finish.hint: You can keep using WardogClips while this downloads.
sum.name: Your name
sum.no_folders: not yet: add a folder later in Settings
sum.no_name: not set: your kills can't be told from everyone else's
done.title: You're all set
done.lead_scan: WardogClips is looking through your footage now: recordings show up in the Library as they are found.
done.lead_add: Add the folder OBS saves to in Settings > Library when you are ready.
done.hint: You can keep using WardogClips while this downloads. The bar at the bottom of the window shows how far it is.
err.no_folder: Add at least one folder, or check “Skip for now”.
err.folder_missing: Folder not found: {paths}. Uncheck or remove it.
err.no_name: No name yet: without it we can't tell your kills from your deaths. Press Next again to go on anyway.
err.vod_file: That's a file, not a folder: pick another folder for stream recordings.
err.save_failed: Your choices could not be saved. Press Start to try again.
err.no_answer: WardogClips is not answering. Is it still running? Press Start to try again.
pick.title: Choose a folder
pick.obs_title: Choose the folder OBS saves your recordings in
pick.vods_title: Choose where stream recordings are saved
pick.busy: A folder window is already open: it may be behind this one.
pick.failed: The folder window did not open. You can type the path instead.
